content.title: My Okou
content.description: One Okou, personal Instructions, reusable Workflows.

items.title: One Okou. Your subagents, now projects
items.description: Start any task with your own Okou. Your former subagents are now projects, organized in the chat sidebar.

media.alt: Illustrated example: Okou beside Writing and Research project cards in Chat → Projects, with Market overview and Customer insights conversations.

items.title: Your instructions are now in Settings
items.description: Find and edit your Okou's instructions in Settings → Personal → My Okou.

media.alt: Illustrated example: Okou beside the personal instructions editor in Settings → Personal → My Okou, with a selected line and formatting toolbar.

items.title: Your workflows, in one place
items.description: Keep repeatable task steps in Workflows. Use them yourself or share them with your workspace.

media.alt: Illustrated example: Okou carrying a folder beside a shared Research brief and a private Weekly report workflow with reusable steps.
